decision_patterns.title: Interest Leads to Commitment
decision_patterns.statement: When I develop a genuine interest in a technology, skill, project, or subject, I tend to commit myself to learning and working on it.
decision_pattern: Continue if the interest and purpose remain meaningful.

decision_patterns.title: Do Not Limit Myself to Existing Skills
decision_patterns.statement: I do not want my current skill set to determine what I can learn next. I am willing to explore new domains and technologies when they contribute to my growth.

decision_patterns.title: Continue Until the Objective Is Reached
decision_patterns.statement: Once I decide to seriously work on something meaningful, I prefer staying dedicated until I complete it or reach the intended objective.
decision_patterns.decision_rule: Do not stop simply because the process becomes difficult.

decision_patterns.title: Explore Complementary Skills
decision_patterns.statement: I am open to learning skills outside a single technical specialization when those skills can expand my overall capabilities.

decision_patterns.title: Decisions Should Support Long-Term Growth
decision_patterns.statement: My learning and work decisions are connected to a long-term ambition of building something of my own and reaching the level of success I have set for myself.
